patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width white, light grey, and light yellow backgrounds to visually separate content blocks and create a clear flow.
Doctor listings and specialty categories are presented in horizontal scrollable carousels, allowing for many items without excessive vertical space on the page.
Headings use a strong, modern sans-serif typeface for clear hierarchy, while body text maintains readability with a clean, approachable sans-serif.
A bright, warm yellow is consistently used for primary call-to-action buttons and key highlights, providing a cheerful contrast to the neutral page backgrounds.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page transforms into a more compact, sticky header with a subtle shadow as the user scrolls down, ensuring persistent access to navigation.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that dynamically reduces its height and adds a subtle drop shadow as the user scrolls past the initial hero section, providing persistent navigation without obstructing content. This transformation is achieved using css-keyframes.
Content sections are visually segmented by alternating full-width background colors (white, light grey, and a soft yellow) to create clear visual breaks and guide the user's eye down the page.

Doctor and specialty listings are presented within horizontal scrollable carousels, allowing for efficient display of numerous items within a confined area, often with a 'See all' link for full access to more options.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~3x body) establish clear hierarchy, supported by legible sans-serif body text for readability.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on input fields and buttons, with circular doctor profile images and slightly rounded corners on card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, maintaining good readability without feeling sparse.

standout: The site stands out with its friendly and approachable illustrative style, particularly in the hero and app promotion sections, which injects a playful personality into a typically serious healthcare service. This visual warmth, combined with a highly functional and data-rich interface for finding doctors, creates a distinctive and trustworthy user experience.
